item.title: Sanjay Raut questions hotel move of corporators after tight BMC verdict
item.description: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut questioned the Shinde-led Sena’s move to shift newly elected BMC corporators to a hotel, saying the fractured civic poll mandate makes the mayor’s post far from certain.

item.title: BJP ‘conspiracy’ to remove voters from Rajasthan electoral rolls: Congress
item.description: BJP conspiracy to remove voters from Rajasthan electoral rolls, alleges Congress

item.title: China’s population shrinks for fourth year as births fall 17 pc in 2025
item.description: Lowest birth rate on record underscores deepening demographic pressures a decade after end of one-child policy

item.title: IFA summons referees over unauthorised match before Messi’s Kolkata appearance
item.description: Four football referees who officiated a match at Kolkata’s Salt Lake Stadium ahead of Argentine star Lionel Messi’s appearance in the city have been summoned by the Indian Football Association (IFA) for alleged procedural violations.

item.title: Calcutta High Court declines to hear Z+ security cover plea by Humayun Kabir
item.description: The Calcutta High Court on Monday declined to hear a petition filed by suspended Trinamool Congress legislator Humayun Kabir seeking Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) security, directing him instead to approach the Union Ministry of Home Affairs.

item.title: SC seeks response on plea for rail quota and concessions for acid attack survivors
item.description: Supreme Court agreed to examine a PIL seeking a separate reservation quota and concessional railway fares for acid attack survivors, who are currently excluded from disability travel benefits.

item.title: Villagers protest SIR hearings, allege selective targeting in South 24 Parganas
item.description: Protests erupted in Basanti, South 24 Parganas, as villagers alleged harassment during the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) hearing process.

item.title: Indore anti-begging drive exposes millionaire posing as destitute
item.description: Indore’s anti-begging drive has exposed a man posing as a destitute beggar as a crorepati, uncovering properties, vehicles and moneylending activities worth crores.

item.title: Kerala Assembly set for stormy final session ahead of elections
item.description: Kerala Assembly’s final session begins Tuesday, setting the stage for a high-voltage showdown as parties gear up for the state elections.

item.title: 'Meagre' fine: Pilots’ body flays DGCA over Rs 22.20-cr penalty on IndiGo
item.description: FIP calls fine ‘very meagre’, questions scope of probe into December flight disruptions that hit over three lakh travellers
